description: Estimates the dollar cost of holding an ETF: expense ratio over a holding period plus the bid-ask spread paid when buying and later selling. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/etf-cost-calculator/.

amount.description: Amount invested, in dollars. Accepts 0 to 1000000000; default 100000.

expense_ratio_pct.description: Expense ratio, in percent per year. Accepts 0 to 5; default 0.5.

spread_pct.description: Round-trip bid-ask spread, in percent. Accepts 0 to 5; default 0.1.

years.description: Holding period, in years. Accepts 1 to 50; default 5.

name: etf_cost
title: ETF cost calculator
